/shore-excursions/ancient-aptera-excursi.metaDescription: Visit Ancient Aptera's Roman ruins, theatre and Souda Bay views on a guided shore excursion from Souda Bay — Cretan history with cruise-timed returns.
/shore-excursions/ancient-aptera-excursi.lead: Ancient Aptera sits on a hill above Souda Bay — one of western Crete's most significant archaeological sites, with Roman cisterns, a theatre and panoramic views over the harbour where your ship lies at anchor. This excursion focuses on Aptera with optional brief Chania Old Town time when port windows allow.
